SELECT /*selectMasterMdCmCmsItemSgSelPopList*/ SG.SG_ID , SG.SG_NAME /* 구매담당자(정담당 SM 이름) */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD3 MD WHERE MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE = 'CMSM' AND MD.CODE2 = '1' AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = SG.SG_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME /* 구매팀명 : 정담당의 소속 부서(SOURDEPT) 명칭 */ ,(SELECT D.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 MD, ICOMLUSR U, ICOMCOD1 D WHERE MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE = 'CMSM' AND MD.CODE2 = '1' AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = SG.SG_ID AND U.USER_ID = TRIM(MD.TEXT1) AND D.TYPE = 'SOURDEPT' AND D.FLAG = 'Y' AND D.CODE = U.DEPARTMENT) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME FROM KEPSGMG SG WHERE SG.STATUS != 'D'
AND UPPER(SG.SG_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{st_sg_id}) || '%'
AND SG.SG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_sg_nm} || '%'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 MD, ICOMLUSR U WHERE MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE IN ('CMSM','CMDSM') AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = SG.SG_ID AND U.USER_ID = TRIM(MD.TEXT1) AND U.DEPARTMENT = #{st_kep_dept})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 MD WHERE MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE IN ('CMSM','CMDSM') AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = SG.SG_ID AND UPPER(MD.TEXT4) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{st_kep_user_name}) || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 MD WHERE MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE IN ('CMSM','CMDSM') AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = SG.SG_ID AND TRIM(MD.TEXT1) = #{st_my_user_id})
ORDER BY SG.SG_ID
